request:
Issue #1033, part 1: a setup / health view. The PR body says `Closes #1033` (the last part).

Settled scope: VS Code: a collapsible "Project health" item at the top of the settings overview tree (apps/vscode/src/features/settings/overviewProvider.ts), with rows for the Spec Kit CLI version (specifyVersion() in apps/vscode/src/speckit/specKitUpgrade.ts), Companion installed (isCompanionInstalled), the constitution (present, template or filled: constitutionNeedsSetup from packages/viewer core if #1047 merged, else the detector's check) and the AI agent configured (installedAgents). Each row shows a check or a warning, and a row that needs fixing carries the command that fixes it (as a tooltip and a click that runs it in a visible terminal, reusing the existing upgrade/init commands where they exist). Copilot canvas: a health panel the board folds away, beside the existing repository warning, listing the same items plus the session-worktree traps from apps/copilot-canvas/README.md (no node_modules where the board needs them, Companion commands that are not committed files), each missing item with its fixing command. No new runtime dependency. Update tests, stories if a webview component is touched, `npm run canvas:build` + `npm run mod:build`, changelogs (root and canvas), docs (install page or the viewer page, copilot-app/index.mdx), and keep the Get Started walkthrough consistent with viewsWelcome. No version bump.
expectations: A doctor run from the health view
